newsitem.title: USA: Edison Bros plans $20 mln computer upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Edison Bros plans $20 mln computer upgrade.

text.p: Edison Brothers Stores Inc, a retailer currently in Chapter 11 bankruptcy, said Thursday it will spend $20 million to change its computer system.
The change includes licensing a retail software package marketed jointly by Intrepid and PeopleSoft, Edison Brothers said.
Edison Brothers said it plans to replace its existing mainframe-based core systems by 1999 with a state-of-the-art client/server system built around the software.
The plan includes a new data warehouse as well as systems to manage and integrate the company's merchandising, financial, human resources, distribution, administrative and decision support functions.
Edison is also building a new communication hardware network including cabling, servers, and desktop and laptop personal computers.
